rules.annotation_note: Human-reviewed necessary-but-not-sufficient age criterion for applicants using the named individual eligibility review route. Confirmed means only that this atomic age criterion applies; it does not establish review approval or route eligibility.

reviewed_coverage_statement: Covers reviewed direct education paths (1)-(3), including completion cutoffs for the 2027 April and 2026 September intakes, plus the existing named age criterion.
limitation_statement: Uses exactly one academic credential and does not cover direct paths (4)-(8), individual review paths (9)-(11) as a whole, overall eligibility, admission, or recommendations.
